title: Emma and the Earl
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A two-volume Harlequin manga adapted from a Paula Marshall novel, set in 19th-century England. Emilia, a wealthy commoner's daughter, turns down a charming aristocrat after learning he wanted her fortune; after misfortune she leaves society, takes the name Emma and becomes governess to the Earl of Chard's children.
life_message: Integrity and self-respect, refusing to be married for money, lead to genuine love.
